nodes.label: Line/Gun System Configuration (Supports 1L/1G ~ 2L/4G)
nodes.rationale: Flexible configuration via D228 (LineCount), D230 (GunPerLine), D232 (TotalGun=RO). Configuration change requires PLC STOP and download; cannot change during operation.

nodes.label: Line Independence Principle
nodes.rationale: Line 0 and Line 1 run completely independent sequences with dedicated step M-relays, vacuum systems, and parameters. Only EMG Stop / Safety Fault cause global stop across lines. Enables simultaneous yet decoupled multi-line operation.

nodes.label: Vacuum System Sharing Within Line
nodes.rationale: Within a single Line, all guns share the same vacuum pump/piping/unit. Only 1 gun can be active at a time per line. Gun selection via HMI.

nodes.label: Gun Type Definitions (Type 0-3)
nodes.rationale: Four solenoid configurations support different refrigerant/oil injection strategies: Type0=1-Sol Refrig, Type1=Refrig FAST+NORMAL (2-Sol), Type2=Oil+Refrig sequential (2-Sol), Type3=Oil+Refrig both FAST+NORMAL (4-Sol). Type per-gun supports mixed configurations on same line.

nodes.label: FAST+NORMAL Simultaneous Open Injection
nodes.rationale: At injection start, both FAST and NORMAL solenoids open together for rapid fill. When an intermediate stop-point is reached, FAST closes and only NORMAL continues to final target for precision. Same pattern applies to both Oil and Refriger.

nodes.label: Gun Global Index Formula
nodes.rationale: Gun Global Index = Line × GunPerLine(D230) + GunLocal. Provides a flat addressing scheme (0-3) for up to 4 guns regardless of line/gun layout, simplifying register offset calculations for user settings.

nodes.label: HMI Button → PLC Internal Relay Mapping
nodes.norm_label: hmi button → plc internal relay mapping

nodes.label: 11-POU Program Organization Unit Module Structure
nodes.rationale: Program decomposed into 11 independent CSV modules (IL format): idata (init/mapping), gmes (main sequence), setting (parameters), gunvac, unitvac, vacchec, refinj, alarm, ad (analog), 485 (RS-485 comm), spc (statistics). Execution conditions vary: always-ON for idata/gmes/setting/alarm/ad/485, step-gated for gunvac/unitvac/vacchec/refinj, cycle-complete for spc.

nodes.label: D (Data Register) Device Map (Even-Address Rule)
nodes.rationale: All D-register items allocated at even addresses; Dn+1 reserved for every 16-bit item to prepare for future 32-bit expansion. Parameter registers split per line (L0=D0-D29, L1=D30-D59), user settings per gun (D60-D115), analog data (D120-D149), calculation work (D150-D189), communication (D190-D269), SPC (D280-D299), system config (D228-D239).

nodes.label: Main Sequence Step Control (per Line)
nodes.rationale: Each Line follows: IDLE → PRECHECK → GUN VAC → UNIT VAC → VAC CHECK → INJECTION (Type-branched) → GAS EXHAUST → COMPLETE → IDLE. Line 0 uses M10-M1A steps, Line 1 uses M20-M2A. EMP/Safety fault forces ALARM state from any step.

nodes.label: Gun Selection-Based Injection Sequence Branching
nodes.rationale: After VAC CHECK, injection sequence forks based on active Gun Type: Type0 = single solenoid ON→target→OFF; Type1 = FAST+NORMAL simultaneous→FAST cutoff→NORMAL final; Type2 = Oil sequential→Refrig sequential; Type3 = Oil FAST+NORMAL→Refrig FAST+NORMAL.

nodes.label: Start Condition per Line
nodes.rationale: START requires: IDLE state, no EMG Stop, no alarm latch, Safety OK, Gun Coupler ON, Pressure Normal, Refrig Supply OK, Interlock OK or DISABLED. On START: PC Write area copied to Working Copy via BMOV, then transition to PRECHECK.

nodes.label: End Condition per Line
nodes.rationale: Cycle completes when EXHAUST time expires; increments injection count, accumulates usage; sets CycleDone; clears PC Write area via FMOV K0. Auto mode returns to IDLE; Manual mode awaits next START.

nodes.label: Process Specification Table (Gun Vacuum, Unit Vacuum, Vac Check, Refriger Charging, Exhaust)
nodes.norm_label: process specification table (gun vacuum, unit vacuum, vac check, refriger charging, exhaust)

nodes.label: Safety PLC Interface
nodes.rationale: Safety PLC communicates via: Safety Healthy → M131/M141, Safety Reset Request → X03, Main→Safety Reset Ack → Y1C, Emergency Stop Active → M90. Separation of safety and main logic for functional safety compliance.

nodes.label: Interlock System (per Line)
nodes.rationale: Per-line interlock relays (M130-M149): Safety OK, Vacuum Pump Run FB, Gun Coupler, Pressure Normal, Refrig Supply OK. Interlock can be toggled USE/NOT USE via HMI (M42). All interlocks must be satisfied for START condition.

nodes.label: Injection Tolerance Check Mechanism
nodes.rationale: Actual injection volume compared against target ± tolerance (D26 for Refrig, D28 for Oil). If |actual - target| > tolerance → NG ALARM + OPERATION STOP. Ensures precise dispensing quality control.

nodes.label: Gun Coupler Sensor Interlock
nodes.rationale: Gun Coupler Sensor (X04/X0A for L0, X14/X1A for L1) monitored during ALL processes. OFF detection triggers immediate ALARM + OPERATION STOP, all solenoids OFF, return to IDLE. Prevents operation with disconnected gun.

nodes.label: PC↔PLC Communication Interface (PC Write/Working Area)
nodes.rationale: PC writes job data to D190-D209 (L0) / D230-D249 (L1). On START, BMOV copies to Working Area (D210-D229 L0 / D250-D269 L1). Cycle completion clears PC Write area (FMOV K0). Write area at 0 signals PC that next write is permitted.

nodes.label: SPC Statistics Tracking
nodes.rationale: Aggregate statistics across all lines: Refriger Total Usage (32-bit Kg), Total Injection Count (32-bit), Total Charging Pulse (32-bit), Last Actual Volume / Setting Amount. Updated on cycle completion.

nodes.label: RS-485 Communication (Barcode/SCAN)
nodes.rationale: RS-485 channel handles barcode reader and SCAN injection data. Time-division or channel-separated. Communication status tracked via M190-M199 flags.

nodes.label: SoC (State-of-Cycle) Split into Sub-States
nodes.rationale: Main sequence steps (M10-M1A/M20-M2A) each represent a discrete SoC. Done/Fail relays (M30-M49) provide step-completion signaling to parent sequence controller (gmes). Enables modular, composable cycle logic.

nodes.label: Error/Alarm Handling System
nodes.rationale: Global alarms (M90-M109): EMG Stop, Safety Fault, Vacuum Timeout, Leak, Injection Over/Under, Pressure/Temperature abnormal, Bombe Low, Barcode/SCAN fail. Per-line alarm instances (M110-M129). Alarm latch, buzzer output (Y30), lamp outputs (Y31-Y33). ALARM RESET via HMI M43.

nodes.label: REFRIGER CHARGING MACHINE
nodes.rationale: Refrigerant charging equipment for factory automation; supports explosion-proof and non-explosion-proof enclosure types per model

nodes.label: LS IXP2-1200 HMI
nodes.rationale: HMI hardware: 1024x768 XGA resolution, LS Electric brand; provides touchscreen interface for machine control and monitoring

nodes.label: Mitsubishi PLC
nodes.rationale: Programmable Logic Controller paired with HMI; stores configuration parameters and executes control logic for the charging machine

nodes.label: Operation Screen
nodes.rationale: Main HMI screen; entry point on power-on; displays 11 data items (refrigerant usage, vacuum level, temperature, pressure, etc.) and hosts 19 control buttons including START, STOP, and process triggers

nodes.label: Parameter Setting Screen
nodes.rationale: Screen for configuring 12 system parameters (vacuum times, alarm thresholds, pressure limits, injection tolerance); reads from PLC and writes user modifications back to PLC

nodes.label: User Setting Screen
nodes.rationale: Per-injection-gun configuration screen with 5 settings (injection model, volume, calibration values, batch correction); reads from PLC and writes user modifications back to PLC

nodes.label: Alarm Screen
nodes.rationale: Screen for displaying and acknowledging alarms including DOOR OPEN alarm; accessible via ALARM SCREEN navigation button

nodes.label: Screen Navigation Flow
nodes.rationale: Navigation hierarchy: POWER ON leads to Operation Screen, which branches to User Setting Screen, Parameter Setting Screen, and Alarm Screen

nodes.label: Momentary Button Rule
nodes.rationale: Global design rule: hardware and HMI buttons are ON only when pressed (momentary action), not latching; applies to all buttons including vacuum pump and process triggers

nodes.label: INTERLOCK USE/NOT USE Toggle
nodes.rationale: Toggle button on Operation Screen to enable or disable the interlock safety mechanism

nodes.label: MANUAL/AUTO Mode Toggle
nodes.rationale: Toggle button on Operation Screen switching between manual and automatic operation modes

nodes.label: HMI Display Data Items
nodes.rationale: 11 real-time data items shown on Operation Screen: Refrigerant Usage (32-bit Kg), Number of Injections (16-bit), Injection Model (16-bit), Charging Pulse (32-bit), Injection Time (16-bit sec), Injection Setting Amount (32-bit g), Actual Injection Volume (32-bit g), SCAN Injection Volume (16-bit g), Current Vacuum Level (32-bit Torr), Temperature (16-bit C), Pressure (16-bit kgf/cm2)

nodes.label: Vacuum Pump Operation
nodes.rationale: Per-injection-line vacuum pump controlled by momentary HMI button; individual control per line; triggered from Operation Screen

nodes.label: Refrigerant Injection Process
nodes.rationale: Injection sequence triggered by REFRIGER INJECTION button on Operation Screen; uses configured injection parameters from User Setting and Parameter Setting screens

nodes.label: Safety PLC Reset
nodes.rationale: Two reset methods: Hard Reset via physical RESET push button and Soft Reset via any HMI RESET button; both act on the Mitsubishi PLC

nodes.label: Explosion-Proof Enclosure Type
nodes.rationale: Pressurized/flameproof enclosure variant; equipped with Left Door and Right Door limit sensors using NC contacts mapped to X-inputs; DOOR OPEN triggers alarm but no emergency stop

nodes.label: Non-Explosion-Proof Enclosure Type
nodes.rationale: Standard industrial enclosure variant; no door limit sensors equipped; no door-open alarm functionality

nodes.label: Left Door Limit Sensor
nodes.rationale: NC contact X-input sensor on left door for explosion-proof type only; OPEN state triggers a DOOR OPEN alarm via M-relay latch

nodes.label: Right Door Limit Sensor
nodes.rationale: NC contact X-input sensor on right door for explosion-proof type only; OPEN state triggers a DOOR OPEN alarm via M-relay latch

nodes.label: DOOR OPEN Alarm
nodes.rationale: M-relay latch alarm flag triggered when either left or right door limit sensor detects open state; displayed on Alarm Screen; non-latching behavior

nodes.label: Door Alarm Non-Latching Behavior
nodes.rationale: Inferred design behavior: DOOR OPEN alarm is non-latching — it clears automatically when the door is closed and ALARM RESET is pressed, without requiring separate acknowledgment or manual clearing

nodes.label: No Emergency Stop on Door Open
nodes.rationale: Inferred design decision: DOOR OPEN does NOT trigger emergency stop or interlock; the machine continues normal operation while the alarm is active; rationale inferred as avoiding unnecessary production stops during maintenance access
nodes.norm_label: no emergency stop on door open

nodes.label: PLC Read-Write Parameter Pattern
nodes.rationale: Inferred architectural pattern: both Parameter Setting and User Setting screens follow a consistent read-modify-write cycle — read configuration values from PLC, display to user, accept user modifications, then write updated values back to PLC
